question.text: A working transistor with its three legs marked $P, Q$ and $R$ is tested using a multimeter. No conduction is found between $P$ and $Q$. By connecting the common (negative) terminal of the multimeter to $R$ and the other (positive) terminal to $P$ or $Q$, some resistance is seen on the multimeter. Which of the following is true for the transistor?

options.text: It is an npn transistor with $R$ as base
It is a pnp transistor with $\mathrm{R}$ as collector
It is a pnp transistor with $\mathrm{R}$ as emitter
It is an npn transistor with $R$ as collector
